name: B2 · Intermediário Superior
description: Condicionais 2 e 3, voz passiva, discurso indireto, orações relativas, inglês no trabalho e desejos/arrependimentos.

flashcards.back: If + past simple, would + verbo. Situação irreal/improvável no presente ou futuro. Com be: If I were...
flashcards.en: If I were rich, I would travel the world.
flashcards.syl: if ai uér ritch, ai uúd TRÉ-vou dâ uérld

flashcards.back: If + past perfect, would have + particípio. Passado irreal: o que não aconteceu.
flashcards.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
flashcards.syl: if ai réd STÂ-did, ai uúd rév pést

flashcards.back: Passado → presente: If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
flashcards.en: If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
flashcards.syl: if ai réd TÉI-ken dét djób, ai uúd bi ritch náu

flashcards.front: Por que se diz 'If I were you'?
flashcards.back: No subjuntivo/irreal usa-se were para todas as pessoas (If I were, If he were). 'If I was' é muito comum falando, mas 'were' é o padrão formal.
flashcards.en: If I were you, I would apply.
flashcards.syl: if ai uér iú, ai uúd â-PLÁI

flashcards.back: be (no tempo certo) + particípio. O foco vai para quem recebe a ação.
presente: is made · passado: was made · futuro: will be made · present perfect: has been made · modal: can be made.
flashcards.en: The report will be finished tomorrow.
flashcards.syl: dâ ri-PÓRT uíu bi FÍ-nicht tu-MÓ-rôu

flashcards.back: Só quando o agente é importante/novo. Se é óbvio ou desconhecido, omita: My wallet was stolen.
O tempo recua: am/is → was · will → would · can → could · present simple → past simple · past → past perfect.
say + algo (He said that...). tell + pessoa (He told me that...). Ordens: tell someone to do.
flashcards.en: He told me to wait. He said he was busy.
flashcards.syl: ri tôuld mi tu uêit · ri séd ri uóz BÍ-zi

flashcards.back: Ordem afirmativa e sem do/does: 'Where do you live?' → She asked where I lived. Yes/no: if/whether.
flashcards.en: She asked me where I lived.
flashcards.syl: chi éskt mi uér ai livd

flashcards.back: who = pessoas · which = coisas · that = ambos (restritiva) · whose = de quem · where = lugar.
flashcards.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
flashcards.syl: dâ mén ru livz nékst dór iz â DÓK-ter

flashcards.back: Restritiva: essencial, sem vírgula (that/who). Não restritiva: informação extra, entre vírgulas (which/who, nunca that).
flashcards.en: My brother, who lives in Miami, is a nurse.
flashcards.syl: mai BRÂ-der, ru livz in mai-É-mi, iz â nérs

flashcards.back: Let's get started. / Shall we begin? · Let's wrap up. / That's all for today. / Any questions?

flashcards.front: Como pedir um prazo / follow-up em e-mail?
flashcards.back: By when can you send it? / Could you get back to me by Friday? / Just following up on...
flashcards.en: Just following up on my last email.
flashcards.syl: djâst FÓ-lôu-ing âp on mai lést I-MÊIU

flashcards.back: prazo · parte interessada · o quanto antes · fim do dia (end of day).
wish + past simple = desejo sobre o presente. wish + past perfect = arrependimento do passado. wish + would = irritação com hábito.
flashcards.en: I wish I had more time. I wish I had studied more.
flashcards.syl: ai uich ai réd mór táim · ai uich ai réd STÂ-did mór

flashcards.back: I'd rather + verbo base = prefiro. I'd rather you + past = prefiro que você... (I'd rather you didn't smoke).

questions.question: If I ___ you, I would take that job.
questions.en: If I were you, I would take that job.

questions.question: If they ___ earlier, they would have caught the train.
If I won the lottery, I ___ my job.
If I had taken that job, I ___ rich now. (misto)
questions.explanation: Passado irreal → resultado no presente: would + verbo base.

questions.question: This book ___ by a famous author in 1999.
'I am tired,' she said. → She said she ___ tired.
'Where do you live?' → He asked me where ___.
questions.explanation: Perguntas indiretas: ordem afirmativa e recuo do tempo (I lived).

questions.question: The book ___ I bought yesterday is great.
My boss, ___ lives in Miami, is coming tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Relativa não restritiva (entre vírgulas) com pessoa: who (nunca that).

questions.question: That's the woman ___ car was stolen.
Which phrase politely asks for a deadline?
options: Could you send it by Friday?
questions.explanation: 'Could you ... by Friday?' é educado e específico.

questions.question: 'I need this by EOD' means:
options: by the end of the day
questions.explanation: EOD = end of day (até o fim do expediente).

questions.question: I wish I ___ studied harder last year.
I'd rather you ___ here.
questions.explanation: I'd rather + pessoa + past simple (preferência sobre o presente).
